tasks.label: FS Lua: Fix Linux LuaLS
tasks.detail: Download the Linux LuaLS build and symlink it over the Windows-only .exe bundled with the Farming Simulator IDE extension. Idempotent - safe to re-run after extension updates. After it succeeds, run 'FS Lua: Restart Language Server' from the command palette.

tasks.label: FS Lua: Remove Mod Link (for playing)
tasks.detail: Remove the FS25_AdjustableMirrors symlink from the game's mods folder so the deployed .zip takes precedence again. Run this before playing online servers that require the mod. Re-run 'FS Lua: Fix Linux LuaLS' to restore the dev link.
